title: Zoho Freezes Salary Hikes as Sridhar Vembu Warns of Grim Outlook for Software Jobs
hook_text: Zoho just froze all salary hikes.
script:
Zoho just paused all salary hikes for its employees this year.
Co-founder Sridhar Vembu cited surging costs driven by rapid software changes.
He warned of a grim outlook for software jobs as automated tools reshape the industry.
Tech companies face heavy spending to keep pace with shifting market demands.
Zoho staff will not receive their usual pay increases this season.
Would your employer survive an industry wide software hiring freeze?
